notes.title: Shopkeeper Simulator is OUT!
notes.content:
Hello Shopkeepers! 👋

The day has finally arrived to open your shops! 🛒

Shopkeeper Simulator is out with its full release! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057580/Shopkeeper_Simulator/

Thank you so much for the suggestions during the Playtest and from the Demo version! Your feedback really helped us in allowing us to create something you can enjoy!

Managing your own store, handling crises, issuing prices, and transforming your small shop into a worthy supermarket! 😍

Check out our amazing release trailer! 👇
[previewyoutube=vJ0jUeklE6g;full][/previewyoutube]

If you wanna know more, and spend time with cool people, join our official Discord! 💬

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/c1f5a123a1c0cee520604fb90aff524e08896828.png

Let's see who has the best mind for business!

Thank you,
Shopkeeper Simulator Team

notes.title: Release Date Set! 🎊
notes.content:
Hello Shopkeepers! 👋

We are excited to announce that Shopkeeper Simulator is launching on Steam this summer! ☀️

Open the doors to your shop on July 22, 2025! 🎊

[previewyoutube=iWmw2sX1Hmc;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the shoes of a supermarket manager and build your retail empire from the ground up.  Whether you’re starting with a small shop or dreaming of a bustling supermarket, every decision you make will shape your success! 🏬

This is going to be the hottest release this summer! 🥵 Get ready now and add Shopkeeper Simulator to your Wishlist ✅ so you don't miss the premiere! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/765c71d14cff053de031a15b3854a1b3b2e39773.gif

Join us on July 22, 2025 and experience the thrill of running your own supermarket! We can promise hours of addictive, rewarding gameplay in the full version of the game! 😎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/c1f5a123a1c0cee520604fb90aff524e08896828.png

See you at the grand opening!
Shopkeeper Simulator Team

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Is In the Shopping Cart
notes.content:
Hello there Shopkeepers!
The day has come and STEAM NEXT FEST JUNE 2025 EDITION IS HERE!
We are happy to announce that we are part of this amazing event, where all steam users can try out different versions of demo and connect as part of the community to improve those games for the future! 🛒
And Shopkeeper Simulator Demo is one of them! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617580/Shopkeeper_Simulator_Demo/

This is opportunity for all of us to share the feedback, understand the game better for what we need to focus on and improve it for the future.

All your ideas and suggestion we take into consideration, so this is a chance for all of us to shape the game into something even beter and fitting more to your expectations as we get closer to full release! 🔥

So try it out and share whatever is on your mind!
You can do it on steam discussion or even join our community on Discord and put your thoughts for us to take inspiration from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/c1f5a123a1c0cee520604fb90aff524e08896828.png

notes.title: We Are Back! 😎
notes.content:
Hello Keepers! 🙌

We are coming back to you 🫵 after a long time without signs, sorry that we did not give any signs of life, but we had some changes but we come back to you with a lot of information 🤩

ℹ️ Let's get into the important things
Today we are coming back to you with the latest information and a completely NEW graphic design of our game on Steam and more... because we also have a completely new trailer! 🔥

[previewyoutube=urbeJsPni0M;full][/previewyoutube]
Starting today, we are changing Shopkeeper Simulator and we will be happy to hear your suggestions and ideas for the game. The first thing we would like to encourage you to do is sign up for PLAYTEST! ✅

YES - you can sign up for the upcoming Playtest today and be one of the first to try Shopkeeper Simulator 🛍️

How to sign up? 🤔 We are already explaining in a few simple steps 👇
1. Log in to your Steam account
2. Go to the Shopkeeper Simulator Steam page
3. Scroll down a bit and you will see a banner like this, click "Request Access" and that's it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/aa2810f02b6272ba0b454b67d1167cddb964c483.png

Now wait for an invitation to participate in Playtest which are coming very soon... 👀

And if you don't want to miss them, we also encourage you to add Shopkeeper to your Wishlist and click Follow! ✅

Jump on our Discord! 🎮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/c1f5a123a1c0cee520604fb90aff524e08896828.png

See you
Shopkeeper Simulator Team
